outcome: Likelihood of returning to the same hospital for next delivery
cohort: Women who attended their first antenatal visit between March 1 and April 30, 2018 at the Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.
finding: Women who chose private hospitals for delivery were more likely to be older, primiparous, have higher education levels, and had higher rates of Cesarean section, while women who chose public hospitals were more likely to have a vaginal delivery and breastfeed.
